rules: Red contributes 0; doubles token immediately to its right.
Blue scores 0 unless a Green exists anywhere to its left.
Green is inactive only when it is the last token.
mistakes: Doubling an inactive token still yields 0, not its base value.
Red at last position is inert — no error, no penalty.
strategy: Check activation status of each token before applying modifiers.
Sum active token values after all modifiers are resolved.
edge_cases: Red followed by inactive Blue: result is 0, not doubled base.

rules: Red contributes 0; doubles the token immediately to its right
Blue scores 0 unless at least one Green precedes it
Green is inactive only when it is the last token
Doubling an inactive token yields 0; modifiers cannot activate tokens
mistakes: Don't apply Red's doubling before checking Blue's activation status
strategy: Check each token's activation status before applying any modifiers
edge_cases: Red as last token: contributes 0, doubling effect never fires
Red doubling inactive Blue: result is 0, not 10

rules: Red scores 0; doubles the token immediately to its right.
Token base values: Blue=5, Yellow=7, Red=3(unused), Green=2.
mistakes: Do not add Red's base value (3) when it precedes another token.
strategy: Double each Red's right neighbor; Red itself contributes 0.
Sum all remaining non-Red token values normally.
edge_cases: Red at sequence end: scores 0, no token to double.
No Red tokens present: sum all base values directly.

rules: Red contributes 0; doubles the immediate right neighbor's base value
Doubling 0 yields 0; Red before Red is wasted
mistakes: Assuming Red-Red chains stack doublings — they don't compound through zeros
strategy: Evaluate left to right, applying each Red's doubling to its right neighbor
Sum all token contributions after applying modifiers
edge_cases: Red immediately before another Red wastes the modifier entirely
Only the last Red before a non-Red token produces meaningful doubling
Always confirm base values of all token colors before computing final score
